name: motif-for-claude-science
description: Explore, edit, annotate, align, compare, and share DNA, RNA, and protein records in Motif.

interface.longDescription: Motif gives Codex an interactive molecular-biology workbench for DNA, RNA, and protein records. Build annotated records, compare variants and constructs, inspect alignments and sequencing traces, review cloning designs and results, and create portable HTML workbenches. Codex can use its available tools to find, prepare, and analyze data before adding it to Motif.
capabilities: Sequence maps, traces, and cloning workflows
defaultPrompt: Find the reference sequence for this gene, open it in Motif, and annotate the regions relevant to my project.
Compare these DNA and protein constructs in Motif, align them, and summarize their sequence and feature differences.
Review this sequencing trace against its reference in Motif and create a workbench with the mismatches and notes.
